radiology_report:
Subject: Prostate Multiparametric MRI | Facility: LUMC, Leiden | Date: 10 Jan 2025
Indication: Risk reassessment. Prior PSA reads 7.2 ng/mL with a PI-RADS 4 designation.

FINDINGS:
The gland measures 33.96 mL in total volume. On T2 sequences, a focal hypointensity occupies the right mid-gland peripheral zone, spanning roughly 12 × 8 × 10 mm. Diffusion-weighted imaging reveals marked restriction, mirrored by dark signal on the apparent diffusion coefficient map. Post-contrast phases capture prompt, localized enhancement. Capsular integrity remains intact, and seminal vesicles show no infiltration. Pelvic nodes appear normal. Skeletal survey shows no suspicious bone lesions.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right mid-gland peripheral zone.
Prostate volume 33.96 mL, PSA density 0.21 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.8104203.
